===Lore===

Brownies live all over the island continent of Faydwer and are more rarely found traveling far and wide from there. Most often, however, they are found in the Faydark Forest, where their isolationist communities keep to themselves in the darkest corners of the great woods. While not an evil or immoral race as a rule, brownies are so fiercely xenophobic and territorial that they usually attack interlopers on sight.

Brownies are short and lean, typically wearing clothing that matches the underbrush or trees in color. They have tanned and ruddy complexions and dark hair, and commonly wear face paint for decoration.
